label: BRAINSTORM
blurb: Get several directions to choose between, not one answer.

stages.label: DIVERGE
stages.instructions: Give genuinely different directions, not one idea in four costumes — they should disagree about what matters. One line of what it is, one of why it might win. Do not rank them.

stages.label: CONVERGE
stages.instructions: Take only the starred directions forward. Say what picking them commits to and what the first concrete step is. Name what the dropped ones were better at, so the choice stays reversible.
